title: Pixel as the Common Language: Unified Multimodal Embedding via Visual Rendering
abstract: arXiv:2611.30069v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal embedding models map heterogeneous inputs into a shared representation space, yet text-only, image-only, and composed inputs are still presented in distinct formats and follow different routes through the model. This fragmentation prevents heterogeneous tasks from jointly optimizing the same end-to-end encoding process, limiting supervision transfer across input configurations. To address this issue, we propose unification before encoding and instantiate this paradigm in RenderEmbed. The framework uses Visual Substrate Rendering to convert heterogeneous inputs into a common visual substrate for encoding with a VLM. From the resulting visual tokens, Progressive Hierarchical Anchor Encoding produces compact retrieval representations by interleaving learnable anchors and fusing their states across layers, retaining broad context and fine-grained cues. translated_title: 像素作为共同语言：通过视觉渲染实现统一的多模态嵌入
translated_abstract: 多模态嵌入模型将异构输入映射到共享的表示空间，然而纯文本、纯图像和组合输入仍然以不同的格式呈现，并经由模型中不同的路径进行处理。这种碎片化阻碍了异构任务共同优化同一端到端编码过程，限制了监督信号在不同输入配置之间的迁移。为解决这一问题，我们提出“编码前统一”的范式，并在RenderEmbed中加以实现。该框架使用视觉基底渲染将异构输入转换为通用的视觉基底，以供视觉语言模型（VLM）进行编码。基于所生成的视觉标记，渐进式层次锚点编码通过交错插入可学习锚点并跨层融合其状态，产生紧凑的检索表示，同时保留广泛的上下文信息和细粒度线索。干预式渲染学习训练这些表示对渲染扰动保持敏感……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出RenderEmbed框架，通过视觉渲染将文本、图像及组合输入统一转换为像素形式的视觉基底后再编码，实现了真正统一的多模态嵌入表示学习。
en_tdlr: RenderEmbed unifies multimodal embedding by rendering heterogeneous inputs (text, images, and compositions) into a common pixel-based visual substrate before encoding, enabling joint optimization of a single end-to-end encoding pipeline.
